### A

```{r multigroup-portfolio}
a <- read.csv("../../data/stockData.csv", check.names = FALSE)
a$Date <- as.Date(a$Date)
tickers <- setdiff(names(a), "Date")
stocks <- setdiff(tickers, "^GSPC")
prices <- as.matrix(a[, tickers])
r <- prices[-1, ] / prices[-nrow(prices), ] - 1
dates <- a$Date[-1]
train <- r[dates < as.Date("2023-01-01"), stocks]
market <- r[dates < as.Date("2023-01-01"), "^GSPC"]
mu <- colMeans(train)
Sigma <- cov(train)
s <- sqrt(diag(Sigma))
Rf <- 0.001

groups <- c("Technology", "Healthcare", "Financials",
            "Industrials", "Consumer staples")
group <- rep(groups, each = 6)
stock_cor <- cor(train)
rho_group <- matrix(0, 5, 5, dimnames = list(groups, groups))
for (g in groups) {
  for (h in groups) {
    block <- stock_cor[group == g, group == h]
    rho_group[g, h] <- if (g == h) {
      mean(block[upper.tri(block)])
    } else {
      mean(block)
    }
  }
}
group_cor <- rho_group[group, group]
diag(group_cor) <- 1
Sigma_group <- group_cor * outer(s, s)

tangency <- function(S) {
  z <- solve(S, mu - Rf)
  z / sum(z)
}
risk <- function(W, S) sqrt(colSums(W * (S %*% W)))
w_group <- tangency(Sigma_group)
kable(rho_group, digits = 4)
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks, Group = group, Weight = w_group),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
kable(data.frame(Mean = sum(w_group * mu),
                 SD = risk(w_group, Sigma_group)), digits = 6)
```

```{r previous-portfolios}
# Historical covariance portfolios from Projects 1 and 2.
one <- rep(1, length(stocks))
u <- solve(Sigma, mu)
v <- solve(Sigma, one)
A <- sum(u)
B <- sum(mu * u)
C <- sum(v)
D <- B * C - A^2
target <- function(E) ((C * E - A) * u + (B - A * E) * v) / D

W_hist <- cbind("Equal weight" = one / sum(one),
                "Historical min" = v / C,
                "Target 1.5%" = target(0.015),
                "Target 2.0%" = target(0.020),
                "P1 Tech" = (group == "Technology") / 6,
                "P2 Health" = (group == "Healthcare") / 6,
                "P3 Industrials" = (group == "Industrials") / 6)

# Single-index and constant-correlation portfolios from Projects 5 and 6.
fit <- lm(train ~ market)
beta <- coef(fit)[2, ]
residual_var <- colSums(residuals(fit)^2) / df.residual(fit)
market_var <- var(market)
Sigma_sim <- market_var * outer(beta, beta) + diag(residual_var)
rho <- mean(stock_cor[upper.tri(stock_cor)])
cc_residual <- (1 - rho) * s^2
Sigma_cc <- rho * outer(s, s) + diag(cc_residual)

long_only <- function(excess, loading, residual, factor_var) {
  ratio <- excess / loading
  o <- order(-ratio)
  Ci <- factor_var * cumsum(excess[o] * loading[o] / residual[o]) /
    (1 + factor_var * cumsum(loading[o]^2 / residual[o]))
  z <- loading / residual * pmax(ratio - max(Ci), 0)
  z / sum(z)
}
W_sim <- cbind("SIM short" = tangency(Sigma_sim),
               "SIM no short" = long_only(mu - Rf, beta, residual_var,
                                          market_var),
               "SIM no-short min" = long_only(one, beta, residual_var,
                                              market_var))
W_cc <- cbind("CC short" = tangency(Sigma_cc),
              "CC no short" = long_only(mu - Rf, s, cc_residual, rho))
W <- cbind(W_hist, W_sim, W_cc, Multigroup = w_group)
```

```{r training-plot}
assets <- data.frame(Stock = c(stocks, "^GSPC"),
                     Mean = c(mu, mean(market)), SD = c(s, sd(market)))
portfolios <- data.frame(
  Mean = drop(crossprod(W, mu)),
  SD = c(risk(W_hist, Sigma), risk(W_sim, Sigma_sim),
         risk(W_cc, Sigma_cc), risk(w_group, Sigma_group)),
  Portfolio = ifelse(colnames(W) == "Multigroup", "Multigroup", "Previous")
)

frontier <- function(S, model) {
  x <- solve(S, mu)
  y <- solve(S, one)
  a <- sum(x)
  b <- sum(mu * x)
  c <- sum(y)
  d <- b * c - a^2
  sd <- seq(sqrt(1 / c), 1.05 * max(assets$SD), length.out = 500)
  data.frame(Mean = a / c + sqrt(d / c * pmax(sd^2 - 1 / c, 0)),
             SD = sd, Model = model)
}
curves <- rbind(frontier(Sigma, "Historical"),
                frontier(Sigma_sim, "Single index"),
                frontier(Sigma_cc, "Constant correlation"))
ggplot(assets, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_line(data = curves, aes(color = Model)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stock), size = 2.3, vjust = -0.7,
            check_overlap = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = portfolios, aes(shape = Portfolio), size = 2.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Multigroup = 18, Previous = 17)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115 * max(assets$Mean, portfolios$Mean))) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)", y = "Mean monthly return (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### B.1

The portfolios are rebalanced monthly to their training weights. December 2022
closing prices are the starting values for January 2023 returns. The separate
Project 3 dataset ends in 2003.

```{r testing-performance}
test <- dates >= as.Date("2023-01-01") & dates <= as.Date("2026-09-30")
market_test <- r[test, "^GSPC"]
returns <- cbind(r[test, stocks] %*% W, "S&P 500" = market_test)
wealth <- rbind(1, apply(1 + returns, 2, cumprod))
plot_dates <- c(as.Date("2022-12-31"),
                seq(as.Date("2023-02-01"), as.Date("2026-10-01"),
                    by = "month") - 1)

growth_plot <- function(names, title) {
  df <- data.frame(Date = rep(plot_dates, length(names)),
                   Wealth = as.vector(wealth[, names]),
                   Portfolio = rep(names, each = nrow(wealth)))
  ggplot(df, aes(Date, Wealth, color = Portfolio)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Growth of $1") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
}
growth_plot(c(colnames(W_hist), "S&P 500"), "Allocation and target portfolios")
growth_plot(c(colnames(W_sim), colnames(W_cc), "Multigroup", "S&P 500"),
            "Model portfolios")
```

### B.3

```{r performance-measures}
mean_test <- colMeans(returns)
sd_test <- apply(returns, 2, sd)
beta_test <- drop(cov(returns, market_test)) / var(market_test)
premium <- mean(market_test) - Rf
excess <- mean_test - Rf

sharpe <- excess / sd_test
# Compare with the market scaled to the portfolio's total risk.
differential <- excess - (sd_test / sd(market_test)) * premium
treynor <- excess / beta_test
jensen <- excess - beta_test * premium

kable(data.frame(Portfolio = colnames(returns), Sharpe = sharpe,
                 Differential_pct = 100 * differential,
                 Treynor_pct = 100 * treynor, Jensen_pct = 100 * jensen),
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
```

### B.4

```{r fama-decomposition}
p <- "SIM no short"
beta_p <- beta_test[p]
beta_sd <- sd_test[p] / sd(market_test)
mean_p <- mean_test[p]
mean_beta <- Rf + beta_p * premium
mean_sd <- Rf + beta_sd * premium

kable(data.frame(
  Component = c("Market risk", "Diversification", "Net selectivity",
                "Total excess return"),
  Monthly_pct = 100 * c(mean_beta - Rf, mean_sd - mean_beta,
                        mean_p - mean_sd, mean_p - Rf)
), digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)

points <- data.frame(Beta = c(0, beta_p, beta_p, beta_sd),
                     Return = c(Rf, mean_p, mean_beta, mean_sd),
                     Label = c("Risk-free", "Portfolio", "Same beta", "Same SD"))
gaps <- data.frame(Beta = c(beta_p, beta_sd, beta_p),
                   Start = c(Rf, mean_beta, mean_sd),
                   End = c(mean_beta, mean_sd, mean_p),
                   Component = c("Market risk", "Diversification",
                                 "Net selectivity"))

ggplot(points, aes(Beta, 100 * Return)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 100 * Rf, slope = 100 * premium) +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = beta_p,
           y = 100 * Rf, yend = 100 * Rf, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("segment", x = beta_p, xend = beta_sd,
           y = 100 * mean_beta, yend = 100 * mean_beta, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("segment", x = beta_p, xend = beta_sd,
           y = 100 * mean_sd, yend = 100 * mean_sd, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(data = gaps,
               aes(x = Beta, xend = Beta, y = 100 * Start, yend = 100 * End,
                   color = Component), linewidth = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), hjust = c(-0.15, 1.15, 1.15, -0.15),
            size = 3) +
  xlim(0, max(1, beta_sd) + 0.22) +
  labs(x = "Beta", y = "Mean monthly return (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
